verdict.rationale: Kick's docs show multi-entity management: all entities run from a single workspace, each with its own books, reports and transaction history, and shared expenses can be split across entities by amount or percentage. The Plus plan allows unlimited entities. However, nothing in the pack documents consolidated financial statements across entities, so only the entity-management half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: consolidated P&L/Balance Sheet reporting across entities, intercompany elimination handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
